info.title: WhiteBooks GST returns: GSTR9C
info.description: Operations of the WhiteBooks GST returns API in the group GSTR9C, as of 2026-10-13. Start on the sandbox; every call needs your own WhiteBooks credentials and a session as the sign-in sequence describes.
